name: agent-trap-scan
description: Scan a repository for text aimed at AI coding agents (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/, .cursor/, CONTRIBUTING, templates, hidden comments) and flag the risky parts before your agent reads them: download-and-run commands, hook bypasses, orders to revert your work, fake system prompts, commit identity overrides, trap files and honeypots, engagement farming. CLI and Claude Code plugin.
author: Wei-Lun Li (https://github.com/b84330808)

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
